name: Ossiathora
description: Ossiathora was an agriworld located in the Ossiathora system of the Juvex sector, a part of the Senex-Juvex region in the Western Reaches portion of the Mid Rim. The Senex-Juvex Loop hyperlane linked it to the Deminol and Kassido systems. Ossiathora was the origin point of Ossiathoran noodles and was controlled by House Kassido, a noble house based on the world of Kassido.
